items.docs: Version: 9.0.0.cl or later Fetches security audit logs. Requires `ADMINISTRATION` (**Can administer ThoughtSpot**) privilege. If [Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)](https://developers.thoughtspot.com/docs/rbac) is enabled on your instance, the [Admin Control](https://developers.thoughtspot.com/docs/rbac#_admin_control) privileges are required. #### Usage guidelines By default, the API retrieves logs for the last 24 hours. You can set a custom duration
